user_saw: Native Codex model discovery did not list newer ChatGPT models such as gpt-6.2-sol/astra because the bundled 0.164.0 Codex client was too old, and a completed failed turn carrying an audio fileId could fail protocol validation.
summary: Upgraded the bundled Codex runtime and version pins from 0.164.0 to 0.169.0, regenerated the app-server protocol schemas and validators, and added terminal-error/audio-fileId and launcher-diagnostic coverage.
reasoning: The pinned 0.164.0 runtime and its generated schemas were correct when adopted (#181823); they became insufficient because OpenAI's backend gates new models by Codex client version and the upstream protocol added new shapes (audio fileId), both external changes. No in-repo commit broke working behavior, so this is latent with no in-repo trigger; it could also be read as a routine dependency bump.
